MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Wirefy tubing assortment feels useful alongside my electronics screw kit because it could help insulate wires during small repairs.",
    "The solder-seal connectors also connect to small repair work, although I would only buy them when I actually needed to join wires."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The large red tubing requires a particular cable size and repair need that I have not shown; an assortment feels more useful without a specific job planned.",
    "Gloves, medical tests, inspection tags and water-testing equipment do not follow from my interest in fasteners and magnetic hooks.",
    "The air regulator and thermal camera assume equipment or inspection tasks I have not mentioned, while the sealing tape assumes a leak I do not currently need to fix."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying practical hardware seems to have been taken as interest in almost any maintenance supply.",
    "My fastener assortments seem to have been taken as a reason to recommend other large packs, even when their purpose does not match my needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point toward small assembly supplies and convenient ways to hang or organize things; those uses matter more than a general connection to tools.",
    "I rarely choose something without a relevant use in mind. A potentially useful repair supply can fit my interests without being something I would buy now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You partly recognized my interest in small practical repairs, but stretched it into unrelated maintenance needs and specialized equipment."
}
